items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: I’d go into a restaurant and they’d have this Chinese water torture drip of sound of George Winston playing arpeggio triads

ctx.x: I’d go into a restaurant and they’d have this Chinese water torture drip of sound of George Winston playing arpeggio triads one after the other after the other after the other. It would drive me right up the wall.
Isn’t it interesting to be sitting in a restaurant like that and thinking am I the only one in here who is driven to distraction by this music?
